title: Neural Computation, Neuropsychology, Disease Modelling and Self-Healing
subtitle: The nervous system as a dynamic field of executable intentions

blocks.text: N = (V, E, ι, G, X, R, D, C) with glial state as a first-class term, and core dynamics dι_e/dt = R_e − D_e − I_e + C_e + G_e combining reinforcement, decay, inhibition, control intervention and glial modulation. Cognitive functions are recast as characteristic families of walks — attention as competition of inclinations, working memory as persistence where dι/dt = R − D, habit as R ≫ D. Disorders are modelled as pathological alteration of the dynamical field rather than as static lesions.

blocks.explanation: The self-healing sequence and its scar-field model are the substantive contribution: dσ/dt = −λσ + αD, so the glial scar is protective and inhibitory at once, resolving when continuing damage stops and remaining elevated while it persists. The closing box states the framework's own success criterion honestly — same function ≠ same physical path. Recovery is defined as restored function through possibly new topology, which is a testable claim about what repair means.
